summary: Before your salary is taxed, two amounts come off it: a standard deduction that every employee gets without spending anything, capped at your salary, and any professional tax you paid. The standard deduction is larger in the default regime; professional tax comes off only in the regime you opt into. Other amounts in the same list, such as gratuity, are handled separately.

routes.name: Standard deduction
routes.description: Given to every employee automatically; it never exceeds your salary, so it cannot turn salary into a loss.

routes.name: Standard deduction outside the default regime
routes.description: The same deduction, at the smaller amount, if you opt out of the default regime.

routes.name: Professional tax you paid
routes.description: The whole of the professional tax you paid to your state comes off your salary.

disqualifiers.description: Professional tax does not come off in the default regime.
